svg.title: About Minh Khai
svg.desc: Hi, I'm Minh Khai. Engineering simplicity. Building possibilities. I'm a software engineer based in Vietnam, passionate about turning ambitious ideas into thoughtful digital experiences. I build modern web applications, design reliable backend systems, and explore the intersection of software, hardware, and emerging technologies. My approach is simple: write purposeful code, embrace thoughtful design, and never stop learning.
